head: Pedal steel guitar tuner app SteelTune comes to iPhone for $5
dek: SteelTune is a $5 tuner for iPhone and iPad with the tunings steel guitar players use, from E9 and C6 pedal steel to lap steel, resophonic and slack key. It was #89 among paid Music apps on the US App Store on 25 November.
details: It's made by Brett Thomas Lanier, who the listing says is a working steel player. Each tuning can use a needle or a strobe display, every string can be fine-tuned in half-cent steps, and whole tunings can be transposed or sent to another player with a link. It listens through the microphone or a small audio interface and also has electric and acoustic guitar presets. One price, with no account, ads or subscription; it needs iOS 16 and came out on 5 November.
where: iPhone and iPad (iOS 16 or later), App Store, $5 one-time
means: If you play pedal steel, lap steel or Dobro, you can keep each of your tunings as its own swipeable tuner screen instead of retuning a general tuner app.
todo: Search "SteelTune" in the App Store; it works with your phone's microphone, or plug in an audio interface for a cleaner signal.
